game_concept: A card battler set in Snowy Hold – Skating Pond, a frozen skating pond: the firewood keeper must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Helper Factory: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush.
theme: Snowy Hold – Skating Pond: a frozen skating pond
core_gameplay_loop: In Skating Pond, repeat each round: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the refactor_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about refactor_score to power up the firewood keeper and open the chapel bell.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Helper Factory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Helper Factory' (Week 6 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Skating Pond'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how refactor_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Skating Pond.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 12.
